checkedAlternates.risk: French Tarot is a trick-taking game like Bridge.
checkedAlternates.resolution: French Tarot requires a 78-card tarot deck with 21 numbered trumps and the Fool (group-1), not a 52-card deck (group-4).
Skat uses a 32-card deck from 7 to Ace (group-2), not the full 52-card deck (group-4).
